sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Angwish, also called Arwisance, is an Arthurian hero. He was the king of Ireland and the father of Iseult, the woman around whom one of the great Arthurian romances turns. He began as the enemy of King Arthur, then became his ally. His brother Morholt caused the battle that brought the fated lover Tristan to Angwish’s court. There Tristan first set eyes on Iseult.
